workarounds.symptom: dict, set, tuple and Iterable[str] response models fail or return invalid types
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(models): support collection responses and reuse schema wrappers safely. Target files: instructor/v2/core/function_calls.py, instructor/v2/core/handler.py, instructor/v2/core/response.py. Handle TypedDict keys that collide with Pydantic and Instructor methods while retaining requiredness, metadata and the original serialized keys. Adapt dictionaries, sets, tuples, and scalar Iterable items on streaming and non-streaming paths. (Ref: https://github.com/567-labs/instructor/pull/2929)

workarounds.symptom: Streaming extractor drops parallel tool calls whose deltas interleave in one chunk
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(streaming): preserve tool-call boundaries and reject injected Markdown items. Target files: instructor/v2/core/client.py, instructor/v2/core/json.py, instructor/v2/dsl/iterable.py. Stream complete native items incrementally without rescanning earlier characters. Keep fragments from separate OpenAI tool-call indices together and release upstream SDK streams on exhaustion, early close, and parse errors. Report an unfinished item at EOF. (Ref: https://github.com/567-labs/instructor/pull/2927)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(bedrock): preserve Converse inputs and scope bearer tokens. Target files: instructor/v2/auto_client.py, instructor/v2/providers/anthropic/handlers.py, instructor/v2/providers/bedrock/client.py. Preserve native reasoning, tool, and system blocks and convert raw MD_JSON calls to the Converse request shape. Share Claude’s automatic tool-choice rules across Anthropic and Bedrock while honoring explicit caller choices. (Ref: https://github.com/567-labs/instructor/pull/2916)

workarounds.symptom: Partial streaming fails for data-aware default factories across chunk boundaries
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(streaming): validate completed mapping models and dependent defaults. Target files: instructor/v2/dsl/partial.py, tests/dsl/test_partial.py, tests/dsl/test_partial_default_factories.py. Build typed model values inside nested dictionaries and lists during partial streaming. Resolve aliases against the raw JSON path and validate each completed child. Defer defaults that require validated data until the containing object closes, including an explicit empty JSON object. (Ref: https://github.com/567-labs/instructor/pull/2924)
